Context: covered under New Pension Scheme

## covered under New Pension Scheme  
- (a) Minimum years of qualifying service for eligibility of CGHS membership after retirement-10 years.
- (b) No minimum qualifying years of service for availing CGHS facilities in case of death/disability.
- (c) In case of absorption into AB/SBs, NPS subscribers can avail CGHS after their retirement only if the SB/AB where they were absorbed is covered for their retired employees, subject to condition (a) above.
